messages:
Maya: quick note — spotted a broken frontmatter `canonical_url` in `catalog/index.md` pointing to /models/quantized which 404s. Found during a sweep. small fix: update to /models/quantized-v2. I can open a PR unless someone wants it. :clipboard:

docs-bot: scan run — 1 frontmatter link error in catalog/index.md (line 12). Created issue #1307.

Liam: I can pick review. If you open a tiny PR, I'll +1 and merge. low risk.

Maya: done — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 — touches only frontmatter, no content changes. sed I used: ```bash
sed -i 's#/models/quantized#/models/quantized-v2#g' catalog/index.md
```

Rachel: quick heads-up — PMs rely on that canonical for the model gallery; if we change it make sure redirects are in place. Anyone know if redirect exists?

Liam: good call. quick curl check shows 302 from /models/quantized to /models/quantized-v1 currently. Not to v2. Recommend we update both doc and add redirect. I'll flag infra. @ops

Maya: noted — will add a short note in PR description and request infra redirect. Adding `cc: @ops` in PR.

docs-bot: updated issue #1307 with PR link and label `frontmatter-fix`.

Liam: reviewed and left one nit — include `rel=canonical` correction in html example, otherwise LGTM. I'll approve after that.

Maya: sweet — pushed tiny amend. Thanks! :tada:
